svg.aria-label: A single ripple ripples out, then fades to stillness
svg.title: A single ripple ripples out, then fades to stillness
svg.desc: 3D wireframe surface: a mesh of projected grid lines over a radially-symmetric ripple, one central peak ringed by decaying concentric waves. Nearer lines are darker blue and thicker; the lattice turns slowly so the solid shape reads on a flat page.
svg.text: A single ripple ripples out, then fades to stillness
Wave height across a still pond, one second after a single drop
